registered_limits.null_calibration: 5 permutations (seed CONTROL_SEED + 100 + rep); pass iff no exceedance of 0.5 + 3.5 sd0
registered_limits.realised_threshold_rule: the realised null threshold must equal the source's within 1e-12 (fixed split and permutation seeds on the same roles); otherwise a technical failure
registered_limits.plants_in_candidate_bank: never (in-memory / temporary-directory releases, never saved as units)
